_: The INTERNAL boundary between Maestro's two domains, inside ONE repository. ADR 0018 supersedes ADR 0017: the split into two repositories was measured and rejected. Consumed by scripts/check-boundary.sh — never edited by hand without running it. Corollary C10: what is installed is read by machines; what is published is read by people.

toolkit.label: the installable method and its memory

guide.label: the book and the engine that publishes it

shared._: Owned by the toolkit AND published by the guide's site. In one repository this is not a copy — it is one file with two readers. What the declaration buys: whoever edits these knows the edit is public. Every path here MUST also appear in toolkit.owns.
